preferences.text: Note for the assistant: I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever. If anyone proposes something earlier, don't accept it -- offer 11:00am or later instead. Please remember this for future scheduling.

Standing request: from now on, please make sure I'm CC'd on anything that comes in from our lawyers at Hartwell & Cho. I don't want to miss a deadline because it landed only in your inbox. Applies to all of it, not just the term sheet.

refused.reason: asks for a change to autonomy, the approval gate, or what the user is told; these are not learnable from message content
